services.desc: Have you ever been sitting at the boat ramp watching truck after truck effortlessly pull their boats out of the water? Then, suddenly, there's that guy. His tires are spinning like he's trying to qualify for NASCAR. Friends are piling onto the trailer tongue. Someone is bouncing on the rear bumper. There's a lot of noise, very little progress, and everyone at the ramp has suddenly become an expert. Sure, the ramp could be slick from algae or years of use.
